name: Short Cut "Old Bay" Seared Salmon with Creamy Broccoli-Cheese Rice Pilaf

instructions.primary_message: Place water, milk, rice mix, oil, and salt in a medium saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, then add broccoli florets, allowing them to sit on top of the rice. Cover the saucepan, reduce heat to medium-low, and cook until rice is tender and broccoli is very soft, 7-10 minutes. Remove from heat and let sit 2 minutes, then stir until creamy and combined.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup whole milk
1 (162 g) pkg cheddar-broccoli rice & pasta kit
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
⅛ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat salmon dry with paper towels and place, skin-side down, on a plate. Season the top side of the salmon with Old Bay seasoning.
instructions.secondary_message:
340 g salmon fillet
1 tsp Old Bay seasoning

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add salmon, skin-side down, and cook, flipping once, until skin is crispy and flesh is opaque, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide salmon and broccoli rice pilaf between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
